Based on my search results, **Terrell Miller was NOT elected NYC Comptroller in 2025**.

Mark Levine won the 2025 New York City Comptroller election. In the Democratic primary held on June 24, 2025, Levine defeated Justin Brannan. In the general election held on November 4, 2025, Levine defeated Republican nominee Peter Kefalas decisively with 1,501,467 votes (75.2% of the vote) to Kefalas's 448,598 votes (22.5%).

While Terrell Miller did open a campaign account for comptroller in 2025, he did not emerge as a major contender in the race. As of mid-July 2024, campaign finance reports showed he had raised only $60.
